tasks.label: Audit plugin branches and forks retry
args:
import json, subprocess, urllib.request

def run(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()

print('flutter/packages branches:')
print(run("git ls-remote --heads https://github.com/flutter/packages.git | grep -i kotlin || true"))
print('mobile_scanner branches:')
print(run("git ls-remote --heads https://github.com/juliansteenbakker/mobile_scanner.git | grep -i kotlin || true"))
for label, url in [
    ('flutter/packages forks', 'https://api.github.com/repos/flutter/packages/forks?per_page=15&sort=newest'),
    ('mobile_scanner forks', 'https://api.github.com/repos/juliansteenbakker/mobile_scanner/forks?per_page=15&sort=newest'),
]:
    print(label + ':')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response:
        data = json.load(response)
    for item in data:
        print(item['full_name'])
